title: 雪豹幻想角色设定
prompt: Use case: internal self-owned template master production through multi-image identity-preserving edit. Create an exact final 16x9 composition at 1280x720 pixels. Image 1 is a third-party effect reference used only in this controlled offline production request. Image 2 is the sole self-owned pet identity reference. Never expose Image 1 at runtime or in a public sample. Replace every original human, animal or character subject in Image 1 with the exact adult pet identity from Image 2. Image 2 controls only species, breed, coat, markings, ears, eyes, actual age and healthy natural proportions. Image 1 controls every transferred visual detail: composition, camera, crop, perspective, action, pose, expression, gaze, lighting, palette, medium, line quality, brushwork, texture, clothing, landmarks, props, text layout and contact relationships. Preserve Image 1 exactly. Scene-change budget is 0%. Do not redesign, simplify, beautify, juvenilize, thin, elongate, age, recolour or clean up the background. Change only the designated subject identity and the smallest contact-boundary detail required for correct pet anatomy. The replacement must be an adult adult black-and-white tuxedo cat with black crown and ears, narrow white facial blaze, white muzzle and chest, pale green eyes, pink nose, black back and white front legs. Render the face, fur and all anatomy completely in Image 1's visual language; do not paste a photographic pet face into an illustration. Keep the pet friendly and appealing through the transferred expression, never generic, skinny, gaunt, stern, aggressive, uncanny or puppy-like. Keep the professional turnaround, portrait and full-body layout, but remove all humanoid/known-character identity and use a natural pet design. Keep all meaningful text, clothing, landmarks and distinctive props unless a rights-safe replacement is explicitly required. Replace known people, teams, brands, platform UI, watermarks and copyrighted character names with short original pet-safe wording while preserving the same text blocks and visual hierarchy. Do not generate new logos or signatures. Correct anatomy only: no extra ears, eyes, limbs, paws, fingers, fused joints, human hands, floating heads, broken clothing boundaries, residual source subject or duplicate pets. Keep one coherent adult pet identity throughout. This is a self-owned frozen-master candidate, not a runtime request. Return only the finished image.
revisedPrompt:
Create an exact 16:9 composition, 1280x720, as a polished character turnaround sheet on a clean white background. Preserve the reference layout precisely: one large full-body standing figure on the left, two separate head-and-shoulders portraits on the right (one upper-right front-facing, one lower-right three-quarter view), and a long sweeping tail running across the bottom right. Match the same camera angle, crop, perspective, spacing, silhouette balance, and friendly appealing expression from the reference artwork. 

Subject identity must be a single coherent adult black-and-white tuxedo cat, replacing the original humanoid/character subject completely. The cat should have black crown and ears, a narrow white facial blaze, white muzzle and chest, pale green eyes, pink nose, black back, white front legs, and natural adult proportions. Keep the cat calm, warm, elegant, and appealing, never stern, uncanny, juvenile, skinny, or aggressive.

Render the cat in the same stylized anime illustration language as the reference, not photorealistic. Transfer the reference’s visual language faithfully: clean linework, soft shading, cream/black/gold palette, ornamental fantasy styling, lace and geometric accents, gemstone necklace, decorative armbands/collar/harness translated naturally to feline anatomy, and the same overall polished sheet presentation. Keep the full-body outfit and accessories, but adapt them realistically for a cat body with no human hands, no human limbs, no duplicate pets, and no broken anatomy. Maintain the cat’s fur texture and face rendering within the same illustration style.

Preserve the original composition’s minimal background details and do not redesign the scene. If any source text or watermark-like markings appear, replace them with short original pet-safe placeholder text blocks in the same visual positions and hierarchy, with no logos or signatures. Keep the image clean, balanced, and production-ready.
